entities.name: Ranar the Ever-Watchful
entities.description: A spirit warrior of Kaldheim, once a warrior who guarded a kingdom's children, now guardian of the pass between Istfell and Starnheim.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: A god who disguised himself as Bjorn of Beskir to enter Starnheim and was killed.

entities.name: King Bear
entities.description: Entity guarding the passage atop King Bear's Tower, killed by Egon.

entities.name: Firja
entities.description: A valkyrie who ordered Ranar to kill Egon.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Beings who took Ranar and named him guardian of Istfell.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Ranar is a spirit warrior.

entities.name: King Bear's Tower
entities.description: Tower where the passage between Istfell and Starnheim lies.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Passage that closed trapping the jarl's warband in the invaders' realm.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Event during which Ranar's kingdom was assaulted by raiders.

events.summary: During a Doomskar the jarl's warband is trapped when the Omenpath closes, leaving Ranar to guard the kingdom's children.
events.quote: leaving Ranar alone to guard the kingdom's children

events.summary: Ranar refuses to abandon his post, protects and trains the children, then lets the Valkyries take him and is named guardian of Istfell.
events.quote: They named him the guardian of Istfell

events.summary: Egon, disguised as Bjorn, convinces Ranar to help him reach Starnheim; atop the tower he reveals himself and kills King Bear.
events.quote: Bjorn revealed that he was Egon and killed the King

events.summary: Firja commands Ranar to kill Egon and names Ranar guardian of the pass; the cycle will repeat as Ranar forgets.
events.quote: Firja commanded Ranar to kill Egon so that the god would return to the Cosmos

relations.quote: Bjorn revealed that he was Egon and killed the King
Firja commanded Ranar to kill Egon so that the god would return to the Cosmos
